user_prompt: In adults with chronic neck pain, what is the effect of telerehabilitation delivering exercise or physical activity, compared with a minimal intervention (advice, educational materials, usual care without active rehabilitation, wait-list, or no active care), on pain intensity at short-term follow-up (more than 2 weeks and no later than 3 months after randomisation)? If a study has more than two arms, extract ONLY the isolated pairwise comparison between the telerehabilitation-exercise arm and the genuine minimal/no-intervention control arm — never a comparison between two active intervention arms, and never an omnibus statistic (e.g., a Kruskal-Wallis or ANOVA test spanning all groups). If the paper's own reported numbers (e.g., medians) appear to contradict its own stated direction of effect, do not extract that result — treat it as unusable rather than force a computation. Use one endpoint per study. Do not extract, classify, or pool function, quality of life, anxiety, depression, fear avoidance, adherence, or any other outcome.
